Real temporary stores/files/kernel pipes; external protocol/pane/authentication only mocked at designated boundaries. Faults use actual protected file wrapper or SQL trigger, independent bytes/records/process evidence for results.
Serial environment-owning Go fixtures document reason, UUID tmux launch IDs, registered process/store/socket cleanup; no pkg/api or Bun changes. Bun stays sequential.
No assertion weakening, widened cancellation/answer/SQL timeout, retry-until-green, replaced protected file restoration, manufacture of history or fake rollback/replay.
No Task3 public adapter/collector added; no spec/tla changes and no formal jobs. Existing models do not prove new rotation/observation/admission properties.
